project.title: Filipino-Style Lasagna Business Poster
project.description: I designed a promotional poster for a small business that is selling homemade Filipino-style lasagna. The design features a food illustration that I got from Canva, and product description, sizes, and prices that I got from the owner, and using typography and colors that they prefer to make the product appealing.

project.title: Bloom Mental Wellness App
project.description: As part of my group's MMS 150 group project last third trimester, I designed the Bloom app logo, color palette, typography, and UI components for our app.

project.title: Personal Emotional Expression Artwork
project.description: On a theraphy session with UPOU Katuwang, I created a colorful artwork to reflect my feelings and emotions, using lines, shapes, and contrasting colors to express myself visually.
